answer: Attackers bear real compute and energy costs per fake identity, while honest joiners pay only once. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work challenge gating: each new agent must solve a unique, memory-hard puzzle whose difficulty rises with the current registration tide before earning identity. The resulting ledger leaves a cryptographic plume of solved proofs, and a pigment of stake is bonded to each identity, slashable if duplicate behavior is detected. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
